description:
Configure Screaming Frog to extract four specific meta tag values using XPath expressions via Custom Extraction, crawl https://books.toscrape.com/, export the extraction results, and write a meta tag completeness report. 

STEPS:
1. Configure Configuration > Custom > Extraction with these 4 XPath rules:
   - Viewport: //meta[@name='viewport']/@content
   - Charset: //meta[@charset]/@charset
   - OG Title: //meta[@property='og:title']/@content
   - OG Image: //meta[@property='og:image']/@content
2. Start the crawl for https://books.toscrape.com/
3. After crawling, export the Custom Extraction data as a CSV to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/meta_extraction.csv
4. Write a text report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/meta_completeness_report.txt containing the total page count, counts of found tags for each type, and recommendations.
